fusions.name: Heavy Hand
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 15 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Downstroke
fusions.desc: Brings the lash down in a cone that deals 28 damage to everything within 4 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Baiting Answered
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is lashed back at whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Tethered Bruin
fusions.desc: A bear on a long tether fights beside you. It strikes an enemy within 3 tiles every 1.6 seconds and deals 5 damage.
